# Law.com's Legal Speak podcast features David Perla on outside investment in law firms


- Law firm equity


June 26, 2026


-
-
-
-


Law firms are increasingly exploring new sources of capital to support growth, manage cash flow and remain competitive in a changing market. In the latest episode of Law.com's *Legal Speak* podcast, Burford Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) discusses how outside investment could reshape the legal industry, along with the business models and regulatory considerations driving the debate.


Listen[here](https://www.law.com/2026/06/26/capital-calls-inside-the-debate-over-outside-investment-in-law-firms/) or below.
